description:
# The Age of AI Skills

In this age of AI, skills are now popular. Before, MCPs were used, but they eat context very fast - and even unused MCPs were there using context limit, causing money and inefficiency.

**Skills solve this.** Skills are dynamic, meaning AI can use them when required; when not used, they don't eat context limit.

## The Web2 Problem

This project helps with that, but in a **web3 way**. In web2, skills are mostly hosted in git repos - for example, GitHub. If you've been active in tech, you know GitHub has been down many times, and similar tools like Cloudflare have also been down.

## The Web3 Solution

Web3 already fixed this with decentralization. Therefore, I built this tool to bring skills to web3 using **ENS** and **IPFS**.
how_its_made:
## Tech Stack & Tooling

Initially Go was used, but due to WalletConnect issues, I switched to JavaScript.

- **CLI** - built with Node.js
- **Web app** - built with Next.js
- **ENS smart contracts** - interacted with via viem
- **The Graph** (on Sepolia) - used for ENS to display the list of available skills on the website

## AI in the Workflow

AI was used actively throughout development:

- **Claude**
- **Kimi K2.6** (with Kimi CLI)
- **Codex** and **Gemini** - for research

That said, the whole plan and all tech decisions were made by me. AI was just an English-to-code translator.
